evidence.observation: Growth begins at 3.06 Torr, consistent with prior stages (~3.04)
Monotonic pressure rise 3.06→3.34 Torr over 5 samples while Ar flow and T are at setpoint
Flow steady ~100 sccm, so the rise is not an MFC overfeed
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/air ingress cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 (not installed) to distinguish air in-leak from downstream restriction; a pump-down/flow-step test (e.g., drop Ar to 50 sccm and watch whether P falls proportionally) or valve position/exhaust line check would discriminate blockage vs seal leak.
